infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Lony uses contacts so you can find friends by phone and invite them to a loan.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lony uses the microphone so you can send voice notes in chat.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Lony uses Face ID to unlock the app when Biometrics Lock is on.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Lony to use Face ID to unlock the app.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Lony to use the microphone for voice notes.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Lony to access photos for your profile picture, repayment proofs, and receipt scans.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Lony to use the camera to scan receipts and bank statements.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Lony to access contacts so you can find friends by phone.
